findings.issue: Promise.all fires one fetch per unique move in the selected version group with no concurrency limit; a Pokémon like Mew in a modern version group triggers several hundred simultaneous requests per page load
findings.suggestion: Cap concurrency (e.g. a small pooled map or chunked batches), or fetch only the five fields needed from move resources

findings.issue: Expired cache entries are never deleted — only rejected fetches are removed — so the Map retains every URL ever requested for the process lifetime
findings.suggestion: Delete the entry on read when hit.expires <= now (bounded in practice by API size, but still an unbounded-growth pattern)

findings.issue: The 150ms search debounce timer is never cleared when the component unmounts, so a pending timeout can call goto after the user has navigated to a Pokémon page
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer in $effect cleanup (return () => clearTimeout(timer)) or onDestroy

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL is read via process.env instead of the framework's environment module; SvelteKit 3 deprecates $env/* in favour of $app/env/private
findings.suggestion: Import from $app/env/private, which also works if the adapter ever changes

findings.issue: TypeInfo.data: any carries the entire raw API type payload past the data layer, so untyped API shapes flow through every load
findings.suggestion: Keep labels/byPokemon in the index and drop data, or define minimal interfaces for the consumed fields

findings.issue: The Row interface near-duplicates MoveRow exported from the pokemon page's +page.server.ts, so the two can drift
findings.suggestion: Import and reuse the MoveRow type (or move it to #lib/util.ts with the other shared types)

findings.issue: An out-of-range ?page=999 is clamped for display but the URL retains the stale value, leaving UI and query string inconsistent
findings.suggestion: Leave as-is (tests don't cover it) or redirect to the clamped page URL

findings.issue: Non-standard <meta name="text-scale"> — harmless but will draw questions from future readers
findings.suggestion: Remove it or add a comment explaining what it's for

summary: This is a well-crafted, framework-current SvelteKit 3 app: runes throughout, config in the vite plugin, #lib subpath imports, new goto options, and clean server/client boundaries. The data layer is a single coherent module rather than a dumping ground, and comments explain the non-obvious decisions (cache strategy, search race handling). I'd merge it after one nit pass — the only substantive ask is capping the move-detail fetch fan-out on Pokémon pages.
